author: abcoathup
content:
EIP-1 states that last call deadline is typically 14 days.  Doesn't specify a hard deadline.  But once an editor has approved moving it to Review I can then move to Last Call.

> Last Call - This is the final review window for an EIP before it is moved to Final. An EIP enters Last Call when the specification is stable and the author opens a PR with a review end date (last-call-deadline), typically 14 days later.

author: poojaranjan
content:
Yes. If the author expects no further changes, a PR to move the EIP to `Last Call` can be created on the same day it is merged into `Review`. This helps maintain a clear record of the status transitions.

Typically, `Last Call` is 14 days, which works well for non-Core EIPs. Historically, 14 days has been the minimum, while Core EIPs may require a longer period. There is no maximum limit.

So, in the fastest scenario, EIP-8066 could move to Final within the next three weeks if the author actively follows up on the PRs ensuring all bot checks are cleared.
